name: Automotive 12 V controller
description: Vehicle-powered MCU board with load-dump/reverse protection, cold-crank-capable regulator, CAN/LIN and extended-temperature parts.
electrical_characteristics: Input 6-16 V nominal with 40 V+ load-dump transients and reverse polarity
critical_electrical_constraints: Load-dump TVS and reverse-polarity protection at the connector
Regulator input range covers cold crank to load dump clamp
AEC-qualified parts where the product requires; -40..+105 degC derating
stackup_recommendations: 2 or 4 layers; AEC-Q200 passives and AEC-Q100 ICs where the product requires
placement_rules: Input protection (reverse diode/MOSFET, TVS for load dump, filter) at the vehicle connector
CAN/LIN transceivers at the connector with their protection
routing_rules: Battery-input traces sized for the fused current
CAN pair 120 ohm; LIN single-ended with the pull-up at the master
copper_ground_requirements: Ground to chassis plan defined; no floating ground islands
thermal_considerations: Operating range -40 to +105/125 degC: derate every part accordingly
emi_emc_considerations: CISPR 25 conducted and radiated: input filter, shielded harness where required
protection_requirements: Load dump (ISO 7637-2 / 16750-2) TVS; reverse battery; cold-crank operation down to the declared minimum input voltage
verification_requirements: Input voltage range (cold crank to load dump) declared; regulator input range covers it
Clearance for the maximum transient voltage
manufacturing_constraints: Conformal coating; connector with seal rating per the mounting location
unsupported_conditions: Regulator rated for 16 V max on a vehicle input
Non-automotive electrolytic capacitors at the input
